name: Glass Bridge Pavilions — surface and detail kit
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Visible source facts: Circular marble pavilion with very open slender column bays, turquoise/clear glass dome on fine gold ribs, flower garlands and a central pond/fountain. Source palette is delicate glass/gold/marble, not another enclosed domed tower. Hidden layout inference: Set pavilion just off the bridge's main through lane or split the route around its central pool, maintaining one clear continuous passage. Create a small shaded rest ring with views through columns; fountain and plants stay inside the ring. Reuse at distinct bridge stops rather than designing each anew. Preserve this local design. Exactly12 isolated main components in a clean4-column grid. No missing/empty slots or repeated subjects counted twice. One clear front/three-quarter view with useful small rear/top/contact inset per cell. Truly flat backs for appliques, square join ends for repeat mouldings. Screens have repeated coherent holes, no tangled tendrils. Windows separate glass from surrounds, cornices/parapets and posts separate where named. Do not include large room/scenery fragments attached to a tiny detail. Title "B20-DETAIL-001 — Glass Bridge Pavilions — surface and detail kit". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Need radial floor/column/ring-beam hosts, glass dome segment interfaces and bridge/pavilion entry transition. Existing dome rib, marble rail, garland and fountain motifs already shown; maintain open bays. Planter flowers/nearby lilies, butterflies/dragonflies and optional pond fish; passage clearances unverified. Missing detached construction pieces and local interior-facing patterns.
